title: Multiplayer for Among US inspired game
author: AliA22491
selftext:
​

Some background. I don't know anything about game/software development but I have an idea for a game. Did some working, and one thing that I can't decide that which network movement (for lack of better word) should I go for. 

Since its a total AI project. The AI suggest me to opt for Photon with Fishnet, Unity Netcode, Mirror and self built networking as an alternate options.

The caveat is that I dont want to spend money as well because its just a passion project and it might die down later down the road so don't want to spend much.

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body:
OK you already decided your not paying for anything.. your goal is free..    
Ask Gemini how to make a gitrepo.. this is where all your stuff will live... you want to go free so instead of burnign credits you can do this one thing  OR be lazy and make one of the big boy ais make it for you

Grab an account for Claude and chatgpt (you can do others a well) download desktop versions of them. GIve them full reign over your computer.. cause no one cares what its going to do and you don't want to have to say yes for every edit.   
  
Decide do you want more control to move things on the screen OR do you just want to tell your clanker it got it wrong and to fix it.  
\>If you want control..  godot or unity. You will use MCP to connect to them. You can go fancy and use CLI ask AI to tell you what that is.  (If you go unity there is a free MCP you can download)  
\>If you don't care well tell AI you just want to make a game that has mutlipler. it will more likely build it with three.js and then later do server connections with a node server or python... which you don't care cause the clanker will do it for you

  
OK now you have decided how you want to do things.. either a gameengine or not.  Now its the time to use you gitrepo.. which in the end is a folder.. on your computer..  it does version control.. also make it easier for multiple AIs to understand changes cause it logs it all.    
  
So start with what ever AI you want to make the base game.. go till you run out of credits.. then swap to other AI.. wait till credits refresh.. and conitnue cycle till you have a game... 

Also changing models can help..  OR suprise you can download a local model on your PC and make that claner use your VRAM to make things for you.
